fields.description: Issue includes extensive local columns and nightlife items, with prominent coverage of horse racing and handicapping at Hialeah and Tropical Park (including lists of horses and betting commentary). Contains the recurring gossip/column features (e.g., "THEY TELL ME" and "THINGS I'd Like to Know"), discussion of Miami tourism and state societies and the Miami Chamber of Commerce, and commentary on local law enforcement and courts including references to liquor licensing enforcement and a Dade County murder investigation ("Skeets" Downs). Numerous advertisements for Miami and Miami Beach clubs, restaurants, bars, and services.
